development: Camera-trap image analysis with AI detectors and species classifiers
definition: Automated detection of animals, people and vehicles in camera-trap images, followed by species-level classification and shared cloud analysis.
named_examples: MegaDetector (b7-010); SpeciesNet, Google (b7-006; S022); Wildlife Insights (b7-007); IYTE camera-trap detector, TÜBİTAK ARDEB 115E918 (b7-005)
leader_status: Scaled: SpeciesNet trained on 65M+ images runs inside Wildlife Insights (4.5M+ photos); MegaDetector widely used in US/EU studies (b7-006;b7-007;b7-010).
analogue_status: PL: YOLOv5 mammal recognition in Białowieża (b7-009). BR: Wildlife Insights tool at Amazon protected-area pilot sites, programme-reported (b7-008). Indonesia rhino-AI plan not counted.
tr_status: pilot: TÜBİTAK ARDEB 115E918 (IYTE) built a camera-trap animal detector (b7-005); DKMP runs ~3,180 camera traps but no AI use seen (b7-004).

notes: d1 2: unsourced estimate, no TR obligation seen (1 TR search only). d2 3: Biodiversa+ calls open to TR via TÜBİTAK 1071, topic-adjacent (calib-037/049; ids from sources_calib.csv). d3 4: peer-reviewed effort sizes: >8.4 y of labelling saved on 3.2M images, 99.3% of data automated at 96.6% accuracy (b7-011); workflow cut manual processing time (bioRxiv preprint, b7-012); but species-level recall low-moderate, human review still needed (b7-010), so not 5. d4 3: tools are free but Turkish-fauna species coverage not verified; no TR training set found. d5 3: unsourced estimate. d6 3: active university group with TÜBİTAK-funded R&D (not an operational pilot, so tr_funded_pilot no). 3-5y Likely only because d6 +1 is an assumption (no sourced TR deployment/obligation); not Certain. development: eDNA metabarcoding with ML-assisted bioinformatics, reference-gap filling and portfolio nature-risk analytics
definition: Species detection from water, soil or air DNA samples, increasingly combined with machine-learning ordination and AI-driven site-portfolio nature-risk assessment.
named_examples: NatureMetrics (b7-017); Univ. of Hull lake-fish eDNA tool adopted by UK agencies (b7-018); Ankara Univ. nationwide fish eDNA survey (b7-013); TurBOL (b7-015)
leader_status: Scaled in UK: eDNA fish tool adopted for statutory lake monitoring; Scotland ran national-scale eDNA pilot with ~9,000 species detected (b7-018;b7-017).
analogue_status: KR: MiFish eDNA fish survey in four Korean rivers (b7-019). MX: eDNA fish survey of Lake Bacalar (b7-020). Both academic fieldwork. BR eDNA study seen, authorship unverified, not counted.
tr_status: pilot: Ankara Univ. 29-site national fish eDNA survey (b7-013); TÜBİTAK 3501 lagoon eDNA project (b7-014); SUMAE (Ministry) hosted Biodiversa+ FishInDNA workshop (b7-016). Research, not operations.
class_branch: 1-2y: C1 fail (d1 2<4, d6 3<4, funded no: TÜBİTAK 3501 is research) -> C2 fail (barrier none, min 3>1, mean 3.0>=2.0) -> C3 match (d3 4>=4, analogues 2>=2, mean 3.0>=2.5) = Likely; 3-5y: d6 3+1=4 only via assumed +1, so Likely

Not 5 (<=50%). d4 3: TurBOL reference library exists (b7-015) but gaps unquantified (unsourced). d5 3: unsourced estimate. d6 3: several university groups, all research funding. NatureMetrics/portfolio nature-risk side of definition not searched for TR presence; ML-assisted claims are vendor-reported. 3-5y Likely only because d6 +1 is assumed.
